status_history.note: Reopened from Completed by the honest-status audit: the evidence fails the task's own criteria. See blockers.

blockers.description: Reopen evidence: `artifacts/reports/load-test-report.html` is real k6 output, but its target was `http://localhost:4000`, a local dev server. The DoD "System handles 5000 leads/hour" is about the deployed system, and no deployed environment was load-tested.
Reopen evidence: `artifacts/misc/grafana-load-test.png` came from a local Grafana stack that was never connected to production.

To close: (1) Run the k6 scenario against a deployed, non-production environment (or production, with the owner's approval), and record the target URL and the run output. (2) Take the load-test dashboard from the hosted backend that production reports to (IFC-032), not from a local stack.

Re-plan 2026-10-16 (owner ruling "Fix the 15 tasks"): not Completed, no exemption. Stays in its sprint, which is not gated yet. Needs a k6 run against a deployed environment, run with the owner approval; the nightly k6 job from #887 has produced no report in the repo yet. Verified 2026-10-16: Railway production api and ai-worker have OTEL_ENABLED=true and export to the Grafana Cloud gb-south-1 gateway; ws, events-worker and ingestion-worker do not (events-worker and ingestion-worker OTEL_ENABLED=false, ws has no OTel variables). Grafana holds span metrics for api and ai-worker and ai-worker pino log lines carrying trace_id/span_id; no api pino log line has reached Loki yet.
